title: Anatomi QRIS
tagline: An interactive explainer that takes any text — including a real QRIS payment code — and shows exactly how it turns into a QR matrix, down to selecting a field in the payload and watching the specific black squares carrying those bytes light up

metrics.label: Pipeline stages, scrubbable as one continuous transformation
Tests, including byte-identical agreement with a reference QR library
SVG modules rendered at version 15, one shared pointer listener
Runtime network requests, enforced by a build-time scan
